Name: Lucius, Kinsman of Paul
Summary: Lucius was a kinsman of Paul who sends greetings in Romans 16. He is listed separately from Lucius of Cyrene, since the letter does not identify them as the same man.
KeyStory: Lucius was a kinsman of Paul who sends greetings in Romans 16. He is listed separately from Lucius of Cyrene, since the letter does not identify them as the same man.
LifeLesson: Kinship in Christ turns family into fellow workers.
